mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_document (id, course_id, owner_id, title, doc_type, status) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{document.id}), HEXTORAW(#{document.courseId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), HEXTORAW(#{document.ownerId}), #{document.title}, #{document.docType}, #{document.status})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document SET current_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId}) WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(d.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(d.course_id) AS courseId, RAWTOHEX(d.owner_id) AS ownerId, d.title, d.doc_type AS docType, d.status, RAWTOHEX(d.current_version_id) AS currentVersionId FROM edudoc_document d WHERE d.id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document SET current_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{newVersionId}) WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId}) AND current_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{expectedVersionId})
UPDATE edudoc_document SET template_version_id = HEXTORAW(#{templateVersionId}) WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId})
mapper.select: SELECT RAWTOHEX(d.id) FROM edudoc_document d WHERE d.id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId}) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document SET status = #{status} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId})
UPDATE edudoc_document SET status = #{status} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId}) AND status = 'PARSING'
mapper.select:
SELECT RAWTOHEX(d.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(d.owner_id) AS ownerId, d.title, d.doc_type AS docType, d.status, RAWTOHEX(d.course_id) AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, o.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, o.mime_type AS mimeType, v.version_no AS versionNo, u.display_name AS ownerName, CASE WHEN d.owner_id = HEXTORAW(#{ownerId}) THEN 'OWNER' ELSE 'COLLAB' END AS relation, TO_CHAR(d.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createTime, TO_CHAR(d.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime FROM edudoc_document d LEFT JOIN edudoc_document_version v ON v.id = d.current_version_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_oss_object o ON o.id = v.source_object_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = d.course_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_user u ON u.id = d.owner_id
ORDER BY d.update_time DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT RAWTOHEX(d.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(d.owner_id) AS ownerId, d.title, d.doc_type AS docType, d.status, RAWTOHEX(d.course_id) AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, o.size_bytes AS sizeBytes, o.mime_type AS mimeType, v.version_no AS versionNo, RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS versionId, RAWTOHEX(d.current_version_id) AS currentVersionId, v.content_hash AS contentHash, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_document_chunk mc WHERE mc.document_version_id = v.id) AS chunkCount, TO_CHAR(d.create_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS createTime, TO_CHAR(d.update_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS updateTime, TO_CHAR(d.deleted_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS deletedAt, TO_CHAR(d.purge_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS purgeAt FROM edudoc_document d LEFT JOIN edudoc_document_version v ON v.id = d.current_version_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_oss_object o ON o.id = v.source_object_id LEFT JOIN edudoc_course c ON c.id = d.course_id WHERE d.id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId})
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_document SET status = 'DELETED', deleted_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, purge_at = SYSTIMESTAMP + NUMTODSINTERVAL(30, 'DAY') WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId}) AND status != 'DELETED'
UPDATE edudoc_document SET status = #{status}, deleted_at = NULL, purge_at = NULL WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{documentId}) AND status = 'DELETED'
